title: A portable paper-based and smartphone-assisted colorimetric sensor for copper oxychloride
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,10944-10957
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08077K, Paper

Muhammad Adnan Sami, Daim Asif Raja, Imdad Ali, Farid Ahmed, Mahmood Fazal, Muhammad Raza Shah, Muhammad Imran Malik
Copper oxychloride (CuOxy) is a copper-containing fungicide and bactericide used to combat fungal diseases in fruits, vegetables, and ornamental crops. Herein, we developed a sensitive and selective portable paper-based and smartphone-assisted colorimetric sensor for copper oxychloride.
